subject: Insurance evidence & PO setup - Nimbus Supply onboarding
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Insurance evidence & PO setup - Nimbus Supply onboarding

Hi Elena,

Thanks again for choosing to work with Redwood — excited to get Nimbus Supply set up so our procurement and finance teams can issue the initial PO. To move vendor setup forward we need the following items before we can issue a PO (typical turnaround once items are received: 2–3 business days):

Required documents/evidence
- Certificate(s) of Insurance (COI) listing Redwood Inference, Inc. as certificate holder: 1234 Market St, San Francisco, CA 94103
  - General Liability (minimum $1M per occurrence / $2M aggregate)
  - Errors & Omissions (E&O) / Professional Liability (minimum $1M)
  - Cyber/Privacy Liability (minimum $1M)
- Completed/signed W-9
- Vendor banking details (for ACH) + remittance email
- Vendor onboarding form (attached template in the portal)

Please include broker and policy numbers on the COI so our risk team can quickly validate. Also let us know if your subcontractors are covered under your policies or if they maintain separate COIs.

Notes on the PO and billing
- Standard Redwood terms: Net 30 unless otherwise negotiated
- PO will be issued to the legal entity name listed on the W-9
- If you require a specific PO reference on invoices, let us know the billing contact and invoice email

We’ve CC’d Marissa (finance) and Vivek (procurement) — feel free to loop in your broker as needed. If you can send the COIs and W-9 as PDFs in reply, that will speed things up.

Thanks,

Sofia Ivanova
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachment: Redwood_Vendor_Onboarding_Checklist.pdf (application/pdf)

- Billing: invoices should be sent to ap@nimbus-supply.com and reference the PO number once issued. We do provide net-30 as default; if you have other forms to complete for ACH, we can attach bank details in a secure PDF.

Please confirm the certificate holder address to place on the COI exactly as Redwood prefers (we used the address Sofia listed).

Elena — thanks for the quick turnaround and for the attachments. A couple quick follow-ups so we can finish the vendor record: 

1) Subcontractor coverage: does Nimbus require subcontractors to carry their own COIs by default? If so, please confirm whether you will provide a vendor-level endorsement for the first 3 months of our engagement or provide separate COIs for any named subs. This affects our risk review.

2) For setting up the vendor in our system, we also need a PDF of your banking instructions (voided check or bank letter) for ACH. If you prefer, you can upload to our vendor portal link (DocuSign upload accepted) — see the link below.

3) Could you confirm the invoice remit email (we need it verbatim for the vendor file)? You listed ap@nimbus-supply.com — is that the best address for invoice receipt?

Once we have the bank details and confirmation on subcontractors, finance will create the vendor file and issue PO PO-2026-8472 (we will send the PO as a PDF to this thread). Estimated issuance: within 48 hours of receiving bank details.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Manager, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
